title: Hayati Pro Max Bubblegum ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Bubblegum Ice blends classic sweet Bubblegum flavour with an icy Menthol twist. The vape starts with fruity, sugary bubblegum notes, followed by a brisk cooling layer that gives the sweetness a crisp, fresh edge without overpowering it. Made with nicotine salts for quick absorption and a smoother throat hit, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping using low-powered pod kits and starter devices. Its 50VG/50PG blend ensures consistent flavour with subtle vapour output. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
